children: Hong Kong's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose to 3.8% in June to August from 3.7% in the previous three-month period, increasing across most major economic sectors, in particular food and beverage services, the government said on Thursday.

"The continued expansion of the local economy is expected to underpin overall labour market conditions, though employment situations across various industries will continue to hinge on their respective business conditions," Chris Sun, secretary for labour and welfare, said in a statement.
The potential effect of external uncertainties on corporate hiring needs to be monitored, Sun added.
